comment: Submodule lockstep record for the Packages repository (ADR-0139). This repository is a separate git repository nested inside PhaseMirror/The-Foundry, which pins the same dependencies at `packages/*` paths. The two records must agree on the commit each dependency is pinned at, or a build resolves different source depending on which repository it runs from. `.lake/packages/` gitlinks are omitted: Lake owns them and writes no .gitmodules entry. Verified by The-Foundry's copy of the gate: python3 scripts/check_submodule_integrity.py --root packages --probe-remote

submodules.note: Repointed from b54cd15, which upstream no longer advertises. Must stay equal to the commit The-Foundry records at packages/lexlean.
Pin equals the current remote main head, so a ref names it.

An ancestor of the remote main head but named by no ref, so it survives only on the remote's object-retention schedule. Same stranded class as the LexLean pin ADR-0139 fixed. Tracked by ADR-0140; advanced separately because it is a 136-commit, 70k-line dependency upgrade. Must stay equal to the commit The-Foundry records at packages/prism.

acknowledged_unresolved.reason: The pin is an ancestor of the remote main head but is named by no ref. Fail-closed: The-Foundry's gate reports this as an error if the pin becomes ADVERTISED or if HEAD stops pinning this commit.
